description_en: Retrieves a list of feature consistency check jobs
description_zh: 获取特征一致性检查任务列表
kebab_example: aliyun pairecservice list-feature-consistency-check-jobs --instance-id pairec-cn-00000000 --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --sort-by GmtCreateTime --order ASC --status Running --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListFeatureConsistencyCheckJobs

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. To obtain the instance ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2411819.html
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The field to sort the results by. Valid values:

- `GmtCreateTime`: Sorts by creation time.

- `GmtModifiedTime`: Sorts by modification time
parameters.help_zh:
排序依据：
- GmtCreateTime：按创建时间。
- GmtModifiedTime：按更新时间
parameters.name: sort_by

parameters.help_en:
The sort order. Valid values:

- `ASC`: Ascending order.

- `DESC`: Descending order
parameters.help_zh:
排序方式：
- ASC：升序。
- DESC：降序
parameters.name: order

parameters.help_en:
The status of the job. Valid values:

- `ToRun`: Waiting to run.

- `Running`: In progress.

- `Success`: Successful.

- `Failure`: Failed.

- `Stopped`: Stopped or canceled
parameters.help_zh:
任务状态。取值如下：
- ToRun：待运行。
- Running：运行中。
- Success：成功。
- Failure：失败。
- Stopped：停止或已取消
parameters.name: status
